text: As of June 30, 2023, PhilHealth boasts a remarkable enrolment of 103.8 million beneficiaries. This figure reflects the program's success following the implementation of the UHB, illustrating a significant stride towards achieving universal health coverage (UHC) in the Philippines. The extensive enrolment demonstrates PhilHealth's effectiveness in providing healthcare access to every Filipino, irrespective of their employment status or financial capacity.
